headline: U.S. Considers Import Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers
summary: The U.S. government is reportedly planning to ban imports of Chinese optical transceivers. The news has led to share price gains for U.S.-based competitors Coherent and Lumentum.
why: Optical transceivers are critical components for data centers and high-speed networking. Trade restrictions on Chinese technology providers often force a shift in supply chains, benefiting domestic manufacturers.

impacts.name: Coherent
impacts.why: Potential removal of Chinese competitors from the US market reduces competition for domestic firms.
